verdict.rationale: Llama ships open, downloadable model weights in standard formats (original Meta format and Hugging Face transformers format), verifiable via CLI (`llama-model verify-download`), and runnable across many independent runtimes (llama.cpp, ExecuTorch, desktop/mobile) — a strong portability story analogous to 'export and leave'. However this is model-artifact portability, not user-account data export, the license is the Llama Community License (not OSI open source, disputed by community as 'not open source'), and doc pages are gated behind SSO login, undercutting full openness. Missing for 10: genuine user/account data export mechanism, OSI-compliant open license, and publicly accessible (non-gated) documentation confirming portability guarantees.
